name: Sida's Bag
summary: In the Wetlands, Sida's Bag lies swallowed in an ooze near Ironbeard's Tomb. Sida, a resident of Menethil Harbor, fled after throwing her satchel at one of the slimes during her weekly visit; the bag and its contents must be recovered from the acidic creatures.

sections.title: A Panicked Defense
sections.body: Sida visits Ironbeard's Tomb near Dun Modr each week. Dreadful, dripping oozes ambushed her there, and panic drove her to fling her satchel at one of them. The ooze absorbed the bag into its body. The distraction gave Sida time to escape alive and return to Menethil Harbor, while her possessions remained trapped inside an unknown slime.

sections.title: Recovered from the Slime
sections.body: The oozes around Ironbeard's Tomb range from crimson to monstrous, and look much alike. Sida's Bag can be found by cutting down the marsh slimes until the swallowed satchel emerges intact. Acidic muck has soaked the durable sack, but its contents remain preserved. Sida reclaims her belongings, then discards the ruined, slime-coated exterior and offers the washed-out container to whoever braved the marsh on her behalf.

faq.q: Why was Sida's bag inside an ooze?
faq.answer: Sida panicked when dripping slimes attacked her during a visit to Ironbeard's Tomb. She hurled her satchel at one to escape, and the ooze swallowed it whole.

Sida cannot tell the slimes apart, so any predatory ooze around Ironbeard's Tomb in the northeastern Wetlands might have swallowed the bag. Crimson Oozes, Black Oozes, and Monstrous Oozes all prowl there.

faq.q: Why does Sida visit Ironbeard's Tomb?
faq.answer: Sida makes a weekly trip from Menethil Harbor to visit the ancient dwarven crypt near Dun Modr. She keeps the personal reasons for these visits to herself.

aliases: what does sida take out of the bag
faq.answer: Sida empties her recovered items onto the ground and gathers them without showing what they are. She says only that they were far too important to leave dissolving inside an ooze.

angles.text: Menethil Harbor's beleaguered refugees and townsfolk rely on passing travelers to face the predatory horrors creeping in from the flooded Wetlands.
